_ruling: Ruled by Matt 2026-08-13, resolving census finding 5. The inline-exit component (written into the self-contained games by tools/render_inline_exit.py in 8432492, 'Phase 1: the eleven get an inline exit') READS the visitor's audience preference so the exit can route back to the homepage they chose - lsGet('mbm_audience_view'), a read, never a write. That literal entered every exit-bearing game in one push to main, and the per-game static storage censuses ('only mbm_<slug>_ literals') correctly caught a foreign key without any way to know it was a ruled feature. This record is the ruling: keys listed here are attributed to the shared exit component and granted at FAMILY level, so every exit-bearing game's census clears them without a per-game exception - and the day another game gains the exit, its census needs no edit. A key NOT listed here still fails every census; the grant is for the component's declared reads, not a hole. Seventh declared-input record, beside chooserLinkText, gameIdOverrides, copy-authorisation, support-pill, studioBand and new-release-occupants.
